page.title: Signals
page.desc: Demand and inventory signals per SKU — the inputs the pricing engine reads.
page.honest: All values are demand-model estimates derived from the catalog — not observed sales telemetry.

def.velocity: Estimated units sold per month at the current price.

def.coverage: Number of competitor feeds reporting a price for this SKU.
def.daysSupply: Estimated days of stock remaining at current velocity.
def.risk: Stock risk band from days of supply: stockout, low, healthy or overstock.
